raw_html: [[Named item sets#Planar Focus: Prowess|Planar Focus: Prowess]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Named item sets#Planar Focus: Prowess|Planar Focus: Prowess]]:''' When this item is equipped at the same time as a [[Planar Conflux]], you will gain a +4 Artifact bonus to your attack and damage rolls, and a +15 Artifact bonus to your Physical Resistance rating.
